gems.name: pico_phone-rails
gems.info: pico_phone-rails wires the pico_phone gem into Rails: a :phone_number ActiveRecord attribute type, a PhoneValidator for ActiveModel validations, a normalize_phone class macro that rewrites phone attributes to E.164 before validation, extract_phone_numbers_from for pulling phone numbers out of free text (with an optional persisted backend for cross-record search), maintain_phone_search_index for keeping search columns in sync on an existing phone-number table, pico_phone_field_tag/f.pico_phone_field form helpers that display national format for a valid number without discarding what the user typed, live: true on those same helpers for debounced Stimulus-driven validation and reformatting via a mountable engine, and an ActiveJob serializer so a PhoneNumber survives being passed as a job argument.
